parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides support and defines the overall shape and size of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet door and internal shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet with hinges and a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close.
